hero.title_line1: This is not just a game.
hero.subtitle: Dive into a space where play is a way to know yourself, understand systems, and co-create reality with others.

home.auth_required_msg: To create a game, please register or sign in first.

features.title: What are these games
features.desc: Not entertainment — a tool. Every game is a structured situation where you think, decide and reflect.
features.card1_desc: You don't observe — you play a role, make decisions and feel the consequences in real time.
features.card2_desc: Conflicting interests, coalitions, negotiations — everything that exists in real teams, but in a safe space.
features.card3_desc: The debrief is the most important part. What happened? Why did you decide that way? What does it say about you?

audience.title: Who are these games for
audience.desc: For those who want more — from themselves, their team, and reality.
audience.card1_desc: Want to know yourself better, test your limits and expand your perception of reality — these games are made for you.
audience.card2_desc: Team-building games or forecasting sessions — when you need to see the future through the lens of play.
audience.card3_desc: A space where ideas are born. Where play becomes a method of thinking, not just entertainment.

how.title: How it works
how.desc: Four steps from invitation to insight.
how.step1_desc: The moderator selects a template or builds a custom scenario for your group.
how.step2_desc: A character with interests, resources, and decisions to make awaits you.
how.step3_desc: Negotiations, votes, unexpected alliances and conflicts.
how.step4_desc: Reflection after the game often changes how you see real life.

recording_info.title: 🎥 How game recording works
recording_info.lead: Your device does the recording: it puts everyone’s video into a grid, mixes the voices and sends it to the server piece by piece. It costs the club nothing, but it asks something of your device.

points.title: Best from a computer or laptop
points.text: Plugged in. Recording is light there and the quality is better.

points.title: Keep the room tab open and on screen
points.text: Don’t minimise the browser or lock the phone: a phone pauses recording the moment the room leaves the screen. The screen won’t turn off by itself while you are in the room.

points.title: A phone may get warm and drain faster
points.text: It shows the game and records it at the same time. Keep it charging. On a weak phone, switch on “Voice only”: the file is dozens of times smaller and the load is almost nothing.

points.title: What your device sees is what gets recorded
points.text: The room you are in (in a breakout room, that one). Video quality depends on your internet.

points.title: If something breaks off, the recording survives
points.text: Battery dead, internet gone, tab closed — everything uploaded so far is kept. The file and link reach Telegram within a few minutes.

points.title: The link goes to your Telegram, for 7 days
points.text: Anyone you forward it to can open it. After 7 days the file is deleted. Participants see a marker in the room while recording is on.

points.title: The club administrator knows about it
points.text: When a recording starts, the club administrator gets a Telegram message about it.
